items.name: Botswana Nationals 2026

venue.name: Botswana National Museum and Art Gallery

items.information: First official WCA competition in Botswana. The fastest competitor from Botswana in 3x3 event will be crowned national champion of Botswana. Everyone can participate, but only people with Botswana nationality can win prizes and honours. Three spots in the 3x3 final will be reserved for participants with Botswana nationality. The competition is part of a tour around six countries in three weeks. That is why this competition will take place on a Wednesday afternoon and evening.
